Messages.Body:
If a vampires with Vampiric Disease & Perfectionist hunts, does that
vampire gain blood from the Perfectionist as long as no one blocks the
hunt or plays reaction cards?

Messages.Author: floppyzedolfin
Messages.Body:


Sure. His action is successful (though his hunt isn't), and
Perfectionist's blood isn't gained by hunting (but by having a
Perfectionist card).
